title: RTK Query
description: Learn how to use RTK Query for powerful data fetching and caching in React and Redux applications.

data.text: Data fetching is one of the most common tasks in any web application. You need to fetch data, show loading states, handle errors, cache results, and keep everything in sync. Doing this manually with thunks and reducers gets repetitive fast.

**RTK Query** is a powerful data fetching and caching solution built directly into Redux Toolkit. It handles all the complexity of data fetching while automatically integrating with the Redux store. No more writing loading states, error handlers, or cache invalidation logic by hand.

You define your API by calling `createApi` and specifying your base query function and endpoint definitions. Each endpoint can be either a query (for fetching data) or a mutation (for creating, updating, or deleting).

data.content: Creating an API service with queries and mutations

data.text: RTK Query generates React hooks for each endpoint. These hooks return everything you need: the data, loading state, error state, and refetch functions. The component subscribes to the cache automatically.

data.caption: RTK Query caching flow
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Component
    participant RTKQuery
    participant Cache
    participant API
    
    Component->>RTKQuery: useGetUsersQuery()
    RTKQuery->>Cache: Check for cached data
    Cache-->>RTKQuery: No cache
    RTKQuery->>API: GET /api/users
    API-->>RTKQuery: Response data
    RTKQuery->>Cache: Store in cache
    RTKQuery-->>Component: { data, isLoading: true }
    Component-->>Component: Show loading
    RTKQuery-->>Component: { data, isLoading: false }
    Component-->>Component: Show data
    Note over Component,Cache: Same query elsewhere triggers cache hit

data.text: RTK Query manages a cache automatically. By default, cached data stays for 60 seconds before being considered stale. Stale data is refetched in the background when a component mounts.

data.title: Type Safety
data.text: RTK Query provides end-to-end type safety. Your hooks are typed based on the query return type, and mutations know exactly what data they send and receive.
